description: Defines data structures, enums, and constants for configuring CSI (Channel State Information) reporting in 5G NR, including report types, periodicity, CQI tables, and resource configurations.

classes.name: csi_report_config::pucch_csi_resource
classes.description: Represents the PUCCH resource used for CSI reporting, including BWP ID and resource ID.

classes.name: csi_report_config::periodic_or_semi_persistent_report_on_pucch
classes.description: Configuration for periodic or semi-persistent CSI reports on PUCCH, including report type, period, offset, and resource list.

classes.name: csi_report_config::semi_persistent_report_on_pusch
classes.description: Configuration for semi-persistent CSI reports on PUSCH, including slot periodicity, offset list, and power control index.

classes.name: csi_report_config::aperiodic_report
classes.description: Configuration for aperiodic CSI reports on PUSCH, including offset list.

classes.name: csi_report_config::report_frequency_config
classes.description: Frequency domain reporting configuration, including CQI and PMI format indicators, subband info, and bitmap.

classes.name: csi_report_config::port_index_for_8_ranks
classes.description: Port index configuration for up to 8 ranks, including port type and rank-specific port indices.

methods.name: csi_report_periodicity_to_uint
methods.description: Converts a csi_report_periodicity enum value to its unsigned integer representation.
